meters (376</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt268\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt268\">ft)</span> elevation is the highest natural point and the lowest is the Spektesee in Spandau, at <span about=\"#mwt269\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwApU\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"convert\",\"href\":\"./Template:Convert\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"28.1\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"},\"sp\":{\"wt\":\"us\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>28.1 meters (92</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt269\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt269\">ft)</span> elevation.<sup about=\"#mwt275\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-70\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-70\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-70\" id=\"mwApY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwApc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwApg\">[</span>69<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwApk\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"10\" id=\"mwApo\"><h3 id=\"Climate\">Climate</h3>\n<p id=\"mwAps\">Berlin has an <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Oceanic_climate\" title=\"Oceanic climate\" id=\"mwApw\">oceanic climate</a> (<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Köppen_climate_classification\" title=\"Köppen climate classification\" id=\"mwAp0\">Köppen</a>: <i id=\"mwAp4\">Cfb</i>)<sup about=\"#mwt278\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-71\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-71\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-71\" id=\"mwAp8\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAqA\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqE\">[</span>70<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqI\">]</span></span></a></sup> bordering on a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Humid_continental_climate\" title=\"Humid continental climate\" id=\"mwAqM\">humid continental climate</a> (<i id=\"mwAqQ\">Dfb</i>). This type of climate features mild to very warm summer temperatures and cold, though not very severe, winters. Annual precipitation is modest.<sup about=\"#mwt281\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-72\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-72\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-72\" id=\"mwAqU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAqY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqc\">[</span>71<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqg\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt284\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-73\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-73\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-73\" id=\"mwAqk\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAqo\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqs\">[</span>72<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAqw\">]</span></span></a></sup></p><p id=\"mwAq0\">\n\nFrosts are common in winter, and there are larger temperature differences between seasons than typical for many <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Oceanic_climate\" title=\"Oceanic climate\" id=\"mwAq4\">oceanic climates</a>. Summers are warm and sometimes humid with average high temperatures of <span about=\"#mwt285\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwAq8\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"22\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"–\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"25\"},\"4\":{\"wt\":\"C\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>22–25</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt285\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt285\">°C (72–77</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt285\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt285\">°F)</span> and lows of <span about=\"#mwt286\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwArA\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"12\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"–\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"14\"},\"4\":{\"wt\":\"C\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>12–14</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt286\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt286\">°C (54–57</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt286\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt286\">°F)</span>. Winters are cold with average high temperatures of <span about=\"#mwt287\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwArE\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"3\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"C\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>3</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt287\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt287\">°C (37</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt287\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt287\">°F)</span> and lows of <span about=\"#mwt288\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwArI\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"−2\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"to\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"0\"},\"4\":{\"wt\":\"C\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>−2 to 0</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt288\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt288\">°C (28 to 32</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt288\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt288\">°F)</span>. Spring and autumn are generally chilly to mild. Berlin's built-up area creates a microclimate, with <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Urban_heat_island\" title=\"Urban heat island\" id=\"mwArM\">heat stored by the city's buildings and pavement</a>. Temperatures can be <span about=\"#mwt289\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwArQ\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"4\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"C-change\"},\"sigfig\":{\"wt\":\"1\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>4</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt289\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt289\">°C (7</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt289\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt289\">°F)</span> higher in the city than in the surrounding areas.<sup about=\"#mwt308\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-74\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-74\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-74\" id=\"mwArU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwArY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwArc\">[</span>73<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwArg\">]</span></span></a></sup> Annual precipitation is <span about=\"#mwt290\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwArk\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"convert\",\"href\":\"./Template:Convert\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"570\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"mm\"},\"sp\":{\"wt\":\"us\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>570 millimeters (22</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt290\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt290\">in)</span> with moderate rainfall throughout the year. Snowfall mainly occurs from December through March.<sup about=\"#mwt311\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-75\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-75\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-75\" id=\"mwAro\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwArs\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwArw\">[</span>74<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAr0\">]</span></span></a></sup> The hottest month in Berlin was <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./1757_heatwave\" id=\"mwAu0\"><a href=\"./File:Bebelplatz_Night_of_Shame_Monument.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwAu4\"><img resource=\"./File:Bebelplatz_Night_of_Shame_Monument.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1d/Bebelplatz_Night_of_Shame_Monument.jpg/250px-Bebelplatz_Night_of_Shame_Monument.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" 2x\" data-file-width=\"800\" data-file-height=\"646\" data-file-type=\"bitmap\" height=\"202\" width=\"250\" class=\"mw-file-element\" id=\"mwAu8\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwAvA\">\"<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./The_Empty_Library\" title=\"The Empty Library\" id=\"mwAvE\">The Empty Library</a>\", a memorial commemorating the 1933 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Nazi_book_burnings\" title=\"Nazi book burnings\" id=\"mwAvI\">Nazi book burning</a> at <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bebelplatz\" title=\"Bebelplatz\" id=\"mwAvM\">Bebelplatz</a></figcaption></figure>\n\n<p id=\"mwAvQ\">Berlin's history has left the city with a polycentric <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Metropolitan_area\" title=\"Metropolitan area\" id=\"mwAvU\">metropolitan area</a> and an eclectic mix of architecture. The city's appearance today has been predominantly shaped by German history during the 20th century. 17% of Berlin's buildings are <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Gründerzeit\" title=\"Gründerzeit\" id=\"mwAvY\">Gründerzeit</a> or earlier and nearly 25% are of the 1920s and 1930s, when Berlin played a part in the origin of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Modernism_Housing_Estates\" title=\"Berlin Modernism Housing Estates\" id=\"mwAvc\">modern architecture</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt331\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-82\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-82\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-82\" id=\"mwAvg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAvk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAvo\">[</span>81<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAvs\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt334\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-83\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-83\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-83\" id=\"mwAvw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAv0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAv4\">[</span>82<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAv8\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAwA\">Devastated by the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bombing_of_Berlin_in_World_War_II\" title=\"Bombing of Berlin in World War II\" id=\"mwAwE\">bombing of Berlin in World War II</a>, many of the buildings that had survived in both East and West were demolished during the postwar period. After the reunification, many important heritage structures have been <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Reconstruction_(architecture)\" title=\"Reconstruction (architecture)\" id=\"mwAwI\">reconstructed</a>, including the <i id=\"mwAwM\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Forum_Fridericianum\" title=\"Forum Fridericianum\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAwQ\">Forum Fridericianum</a></i> along with the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_State_Opera\" title=\"Berlin State Opera\" id=\"mwAwU\">Berlin State Opera</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Charlottenburg_Palace\" title=\"Charlottenburg Palace\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAwY\">Charlottenburg Palace</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Gendarmenmarkt\" title=\"Gendarmenmarkt\" id=\"mwAwc\">Gendarmenmarkt</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Alte_Kommandantur\" title=\"Alte Kommandantur\" id=\"mwAwg\">Alte Kommandantur</a>, as well as the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./City_Palace,_Berlin\" title=\"City Palace, Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAwk\">City Palace</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAwo\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_tallest_buildings_in_Berlin\" title=\"List of tallest buildings in Berlin\" id=\"mwAws\">tallest buildings in Berlin</a> are spread across the urban area, with clusters at <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Potsdamer_Platz\" title=\"Potsdamer Platz\" id=\"mwAww\">Potsdamer Platz</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./City_West\" title=\"City West\" id=\"mwAw0\">City West</a>, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Alexanderplatz\" title=\"Alexanderplatz\" id=\"mwAw4\">Alexanderplatz</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAw8\">Over <style data-mw-deduplicate=\"TemplateStyles:r1154941027\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles mw:Transclusion\" about=\"#mwt335\" id=\"mwAxA\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Fraction/styles.css\"},\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"frac\",\"href\":\"./Template:Frac\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"1\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"3\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>.mw-parser-output about=\"#mwt335\" id=\"mwAxE\"><span class=\"num\">1</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">⁄</span><span class=\"den\">3</span></span> of the city's area consists of green and open space;<sup about=\"#mwt337\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Senatsverwaltung_für_Umwelt,_Verkehr_und_Klimaschutz_Berlin,_Referat_Freiraumplanung_und_Stadtgrün_19-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAxQ\">[</span>18<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwAxU\">]</span></span></a></sup> the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Großer_Tiergarten\" title=\"Großer Tiergarten\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAxY\">Großer Tiergarten</a>, one of the largest and most popular parks in Berlin is located in the city centre.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"13\" id=\"mwAxc\"><h3 id=\"Architecture\">Architecture</h3>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt338\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwAxg\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Architecture of Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt339\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt338\" id=\"mwAxk\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Architecture_of_Berlin\" title=\"Architecture of Berlin\">Architecture of Berlin</a></div>\n\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt340\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwAxo\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Further\",\"href\":\"./Template:Further\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"List of sights in Berlin\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"List of tallest buildings in Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt341\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt340\" id=\"mwAxs\">Further information: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_sights_in_Berlin\" title=\"List of sights in Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\">List of sights in Berlin</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_tallest_buildings_in_Berlin\" title=\"List of tallest buildings in Berlin\">List of tallest buildings in Berlin</a></div>\n\n<p id=\"mwAxw\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Fernsehturm_Berlin\" title=\"Fernsehturm Berlin\" id=\"mwAx0\">Fernsehturm</a> (TV tower) at <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Alexanderplatz\" title=\"Alexanderplatz\" id=\"mwAx4\">Alexanderplatz</a> in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Mitte\" title=\"Mitte\" id=\"mwAx8\">Mitte</a> is among the tallest structures in the European Union at <span about=\"#mwt342\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwAyA\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"368\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>368</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt342\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt342\">m (1,207</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt342\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt342\">ft)</span>. Built in 1969, it is visible throughout most of the central districts of Berlin. The city can be viewed from its <span about=\"#mwt343\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwAyE\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"convert\",\"href\":\"./Template:Convert\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"204\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"ft\"},\"adj\":{\"wt\":\"mid\"},\"4\":{\"wt\":\"-high\"},\"sp\":{\"wt\":\"us\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>204-meter-high (669</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt343\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt343\">ft)</span> observation floor. Starting here, the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Karl-Marx-Allee\" title=\"Karl-Marx-Allee\" id=\"mwAyI\">Karl-Marx-Allee</a> heads east, an avenue lined by monumental residential buildings, designed in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Socialist_Classicism\" title=\"Socialist Classicism\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAyM\">Socialist Classicism</a> style. Adjacent to this area is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Rotes_Rathaus\" title=\"Rotes Rathaus\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAyQ\">Rotes Rathaus</a> (City Hall), with its distinctive red-brick architecture. In front of it is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neptunbrunnen_(Berlin)\" title=\"Neptunbrunnen (Berlin)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAyU\">Neptunbrunnen</a>, a fountain featuring a mythological group of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Triton_(mythology)\" title=\"Triton (mythology)\" id=\"mwAyY\">Tritons</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Personification\" title=\"Personification\" id=\"mwAyc\">personifications</a> of the four main Prussian rivers, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neptune_(mythology)\" title=\"Neptune (mythology)\" id=\"mwAyg\">Neptune</a> on top of it. Nearby is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Nikolaiviertel\" title=\"Nikolaiviertel\" id=\"mwAyk\">Nikolaiviertel</a>, the reconstructed oldest settlement area in the city.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAyo\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brandenburg_Gate\" title=\"Brandenburg Gate\" id=\"mwAys\">Brandenburg Gate</a> is an iconic landmark of Berlin and Germany; it stands as a symbol of eventful European history and of unity and peace. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Reichstag_building\" title=\"Reichstag building\" id=\"mwAyw\">Reichstag building</a> is the traditional seat of the German Parliament. It was remodeled by British architect <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Norman_Foster_(architect)\" title=\"Norman Foster (architect)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAy0\">Norman Foster</a> in the 1990s and features a glass dome over the session area, which allows free public access to the parliamentary proceedings and magnificent views of the city.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAy4\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./East_Side_Gallery\" title=\"East Side Gallery\" id=\"mwAy8\">East Side Gallery</a> is an open-air exhibition of art painted directly on the last existing portions of the Berlin Wall. It is the largest remaining evidence of the city's historical division.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAzA\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Gendarmenmarkt\" title=\"Gendarmenmarkt\" id=\"mwAzE\">Gendarmenmarkt</a> is a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neoclassical_architecture\" title=\"Neoclassical architecture\" id=\"mwAzI\">neoclassical</a> square in Berlin, the name of which derives from the headquarters of the famous Gens d'armes regiment located here in the 18th century. Two similarly designed cathedrals border it, the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Französischer_Dom\" title=\"Französischer Dom\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAzM\">Französischer Dom</a> with its observation platform and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutscher_Dom\" title=\"Deutscher Dom\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwAzQ\">Deutscher Dom</a>. The Konzerthaus (Concert Hall), home of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Symphony_Orchestra\" title=\"Berlin Symphony Orchestra\" class=\"mw-disambig\" id=\"mwAzU\">Berlin Symphony Orchestra</a>, stands between the two cathedrals.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwAzY\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Museum_Island\" title=\"Museum Island\" id=\"mwAzc\">Museum Island</a> in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Spree_(river)\" title=\"Spree (river)\" id=\"mwAzg\">River Spree</a> houses <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin#Museums\" class=\"mw-selflink-fragment\" id=\"mwAzk\">five museums</a> built from 1830 to 1930 and is a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./UNESCO\" title=\"UNESCO\" id=\"mwAzo\">UNESCO</a> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_World_Heritage_Sites_in_Germany\" title=\"List of World Heritage Sites in Germany\" id=\"mwAzs\">World Heritage</a> site. Restoration and construction of a main entrance to all museums (<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./James_Simon_Gallery\" title=\"James Simon Gallery\" id=\"mwAzw\">James Simon Gallery</a>), as well as reconstruction of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Palace\" title=\"Berlin Palace\" id=\"mwAz0\">Berlin Palace</a> (Stadtschloss) were completed.<sup about=\"#mwt346\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-84\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-84\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-84\" id=\"mwAz4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwAz8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA0A\">[</span>83<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA0E\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt349\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-85\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-85\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-85\" id=\"mwA0I\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwA0M\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA0Q\">[</span>84<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA0U\">]</span></span></a></sup> Also on the island and next to the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Lustgarten\" title=\"Lustgarten\" id=\"mwA0Y\">Lustgarten</a> and palace is <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Cathedral\" title=\"Berlin Cathedral\" id=\"mwA0c\">Berlin Cathedral</a>, emperor William II's ambitious attempt to create a Protestant counterpart to <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./St._Peter's_Basilica\" title=\"St. Peter's Basilica\" id=\"mwA0g\">St. Peter's Basilica</a> in Rome. A large crypt houses the remains of some of the earlier Prussian royal family. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./St._Hedwig's_Cathedral\" title=\"St. Hedwig's Cathedral\" id=\"mwA0k\">St. Hedwig's Cathedral</a> is Berlin's Roman Catholic cathedral.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA0o\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Unter_den_Linden\" title=\"Unter den Linden\" id=\"mwA0s\">Unter den Linden</a> is a tree-lined east–west avenue from the Brandenburg Gate to the Berlin Palace, and was once Berlin's premier promenade. Many Classical buildings line the street, and part of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Humboldt_University\" title=\"Humboldt University\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA0w\">Humboldt University</a> is there. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Friedrichstraße\" title=\"Friedrichstraße\" id=\"mwA00\">Friedrichstraße</a> was Berlin's legendary street during the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Golden_Twenties\" title=\"Golden Twenties\" id=\"mwA04\">Golden Twenties</a>. It combines 20th-century traditions with the modern architecture of today's Berlin.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA08\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Potsdamer_Platz\" title=\"Potsdamer Platz\" id=\"mwA1A\">Potsdamer Platz</a> is an entire quarter built from scratch after the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Wall\" title=\"Berlin Wall\" id=\"mwA1E\">Wall</a> came down.<sup about=\"#mwt352\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-86\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-86\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-86\" id=\"mwA1I\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwA1M\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA1Q\">[</span>85<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA1U\">]</span></span></a></sup> To the west of Potsdamer Platz is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kulturforum\" title=\"Kulturforum\" id=\"mwA1Y\">Kulturforum</a>, which houses the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Gemäldegalerie,_Berlin\" title=\"Gemäldegalerie, Berlin\" id=\"mwA1c\">Gemäldegalerie</a>, and is flanked by the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neue_Nationalgalerie\" title=\"Neue Nationalgalerie\" id=\"mwA1g\">Neue Nationalgalerie</a> and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berliner_Philharmonie\" title=\"Berliner Philharmonie\" id=\"mwA1k\">Berliner Philharmonie</a>. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Memorial_to_the_Murdered_Jews_of_Europe\" title=\"Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe\" id=\"mwA1o\">Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe</a>, a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Holocaust\" title=\"Holocaust\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA1s\">Holocaust</a> memorial, is to the north.<sup about=\"#mwt356\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-87\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-87\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-87\" id=\"mwA1w\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwA10\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA14\">[</span>86<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwA18\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA2A\">The area around <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Hackescher_Markt\" title=\"Hackescher Markt\" id=\"mwA2E\">Hackescher Markt</a> is home to fashionable culture, with countless clothing outlets, clubs, bars, and galleries. This includes the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Hackesche_Höfe\" title=\"Hackesche Höfe\" id=\"mwA2I\">Hackesche Höfe</a>, a conglomeration of buildings around several courtyards, reconstructed around 1996. The nearby <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./New_Synagogue,_Berlin\" title=\"New Synagogue, Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA2M\">New Synagogue</a> is the center of Jewish culture.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA2Q\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Straße_des_17._Juni\" title=\"Straße des 17. Juni\" id=\"mwA2U\">Straße des 17. Juni</a>, connecting the Brandenburg Gate and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Ernst-Reuter-Platz\" title=\"Ernst-Reuter-Platz\" id=\"mwA2Y\">Ernst-Reuter-Platz</a>, serves as the central east–west axis. Its name commemorates the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Uprising_of_1953_in_East_Germany\" title=\"Uprising of 1953 in East Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA2c\">uprisings in East Berlin of 17 June 1953</a>. Approximately halfway from the Brandenburg Gate is the Großer Stern, a circular traffic island on which the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Victory_Column\" title=\"Berlin Victory Column\" id=\"mwA2g\">Siegessäule</a> (Victory Column) is situated. This monument, built to commemorate Prussia's victories, was relocated in 1938–39 from its previous position in front of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Reichstag_building\" title=\"Reichstag building\" id=\"mwA2k\">Reichstag</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA2o\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kurfürstendamm\" title=\"Kurfürstendamm\" id=\"mwA2s\">Kurfürstendamm</a> is home to some of Berlin's luxurious stores with the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kaiser_Wilhelm_Memorial_Church\" title=\"Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church\" id=\"mwA2w\">Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church</a> at its eastern end on <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Breitscheidplatz\" title=\"Breitscheidplatz\" id=\"mwA20\">Breitscheidplatz</a>. The church was destroyed in the Second World War and left in ruins. Nearby on <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Tauentzienstraße\" title=\"Tauentzienstraße\" id=\"mwA24\">Tauentzienstraße</a> is <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./KaDeWe\" title=\"KaDeWe\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA28\">KaDeWe</a>, claimed to be continental Europe's largest department store. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Rathaus_Schöneberg\" title=\"Rathaus Schöneberg\" id=\"mwA3A\">Rathaus Schöneberg</a>, where <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./John_F._Kennedy\" title=\"John F. Kennedy\" id=\"mwA3E\">John F. Kennedy</a> made his famous \"<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Ich_bin_ein_Berliner\" title=\"Ich bin ein Berliner\" id=\"mwA3I\">Ich bin ein Berliner</a>!\" speech, is in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Tempelhof-Schöneberg\" title=\"Tempelhof-Schöneberg\" id=\"mwA3M\">Tempelhof-Schöneberg</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA3Q\">West of the center, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bellevue_Palace_(Germany)\" title=\"Bellevue Palace (Germany)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA3U\">Bellevue Palace</a> is the residence of the German President. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Charlottenburg_Palace\" title=\"Charlottenburg Palace\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA3Y\">Charlottenburg Palace</a>, which was burnt out in the Second World War, is the largest historical palace in Berlin.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA3c\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Funkturm_Berlin\" title=\"Funkturm Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA3g\">Funkturm Berlin</a> is a <span about=\"#mwt357\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwA3k\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"convert\",\"href\":\"./Template:Convert\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"150\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"ft\"},\"adj\":{\"wt\":\"mid\"},\"4\":{\"wt\":\"-tall\"},\"sp\":{\"wt\":\"us\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>150-meter-tall (490</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt357\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt357\">ft)</span> lattice radio tower in the fairground area, built between 1924 and 1926. It is the only observation tower which stands on insulators and has a restaurant <span about=\"#mwt358\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwA3o\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"55\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>55</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt358\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt358\">m (180</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt358\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt358\">ft)</span> and an observation deck <span about=\"#mwt359\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwA3s\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"cvt\",\"href\":\"./Template:Cvt\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"126\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>126</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt359\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt359\">m (413</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt359\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt359\">ft)</span> above ground, which is reachable by a windowed elevator.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA3w\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Oberbaumbrücke\" title=\"Oberbaumbrücke\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA30\">Oberbaumbrücke</a> over the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Spree_(river)\" title=\"Spree (river)\" id=\"mwA34\">Spree river</a> is Berlin's most iconic bridge, connecting the now-combined boroughs of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Friedrichshain\" title=\"Friedrichshain\" id=\"mwA38\">Friedrichshain</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kreuzberg\" title=\"Kreuzberg\" id=\"mwA4A\">Kreuzberg</a>. It carries vehicles, pedestrians, and the U1 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_U-Bahn\" title=\"Berlin U-Bahn\" id=\"mwA4E\">Berlin U-Bahn</a> line. The bridge was completed in a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brick_gothic\" title=\"Brick gothic\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA4I\">brick gothic</a> style in 1896, replacing the former wooden bridge with an upper deck for the U-Bahn. The center portion was demolished in 1945 to stop the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Red_Army\" title=\"Red Army\" id=\"mwA4M\">Red Army</a> from crossing. After the war, the repaired bridge served as a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_border_crossings\" title=\"Berlin border crossings\" id=\"mwA4Q\">checkpoint and border crossing</a> between the Soviet and American sectors, and later between East and West Berlin. In the mid-1950s, it was closed to vehicles, and after the construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961, pedestrian traffic was heavily restricted. Following German reunification, the center portion was reconstructed with a steel frame, and U-Bahn service resumed in 1995.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwA4U\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Washingtonplatz?action=edit&amp;redlink=1\" title=\"Washingtonplatz\" about=\"#mwt360\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion mw:LocalizedAttrs\" class=\"new\" id=\"mwA4Y\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"ill\",\"href\":\"./Template:Ill\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Washingtonplatz\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"de\"}},\"i\":0}}]}' data-mw-i18n='{\"title\":{\"lang\":\"x-page\",\"key\":\"red-link-title\",\"params\":[\"Washingtonplatz\"]}}'>Washingtonplatz</a><span class=\"noprint\" style=\"font-size:85%; font-style: normal; \" about=\"#mwt360\" id=\"mwA4c\"><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\"> </span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">[</span><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink/Interwiki\" href=\"https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washingtonplatz\" title=\"de:Washingtonplatz\" class=\"extiw\">de</a><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">]</span></span> is located in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Moabit\" title=\"Moabit\" id=\"mwA4g\">Moabit</a> area, on the southern side of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_central_station\" title=\"Berlin central station\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA4k\">Berlin central station</a>, between the train station building and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Spree_Canal\" title=\"Spree Canal\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA4o\">Spree</a>, linking the station to the parliament and government quarter. The square was refurbished in 2010-2013, covered in Silesian granite and landscaping features added.<sup about=\"#mwt363\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-88\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-88\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-88\" id=\"mwA4s\"><span known as <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cube_Berlin\" title=\"Cube Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwA48\">Cube Berlin</a>, completed in 2020, is on Washingtonplatz.<sup about=\"#mwt366\" The number of deaths was 32,314. Almost 2 million households were counted in the city, of which 54% were inhabited by a single person. More than 337,000 families with children under the age of 18 lived in Berlin. In 2014, the German capital registered a migration surplus of approximately 40,000 people.<sup about=\"#mwt390\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-94\" rel=\"dc:references\" id=\"mwBIc\">National and international migration into the city has a long history. In 1685, after the revocation of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Edict_of_Nantes\" title=\"Edict of Nantes\" id=\"mwBIg\">Edict of Nantes</a> in France, the city responded with the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Edict_of_Potsdam\" title=\"Edict of Potsdam\" id=\"mwBIk\">Edict of Potsdam</a>, which guaranteed religious freedom and tax-free status to French Huguenot refugees for ten years. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Greater_Berlin_Act\" title=\"Greater Berlin Act\" id=\"mwBIo\">Greater Berlin Act</a> in 1920 incorporated many suburbs and surrounding cities of Berlin. It formed most of the territory that comprises modern Berlin and increased the population from 1.9<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwBIs\"> </span>million to 4<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwBIw\"> </span>million.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBI0\">Active immigration and asylum politics in West Berlin triggered waves of immigration in the 1960s and 1970s. Berlin is home to at least 180,000 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Turkish_people\" title=\"Turkish people\" id=\"mwBI4\">Turkish</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Turks_in_Germany\" title=\"Turks in Germany\" id=\"mwBI8\">Turkish German</a> residents,<sup about=\"#mwt409\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg_95-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg-95\" id=\"mwBJA\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBJE\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJI\">[</span>94<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJM\">]</span></span></a></sup> making it the largest Turkish community outside of Turkey.<sup about=\"#mwt412\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-96\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-96\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-96\" id=\"mwBJQ\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBJU\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJY\">[</span>95<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJc\">]</span></span></a></sup> In the 1990s the <i id=\"mwBJg\">Aussiedlergesetze</i> enabled immigration to Germany of some residents from the former <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Soviet_Union\" title=\"Soviet Union\" id=\"mwBJk\">Soviet Union</a>. Today ethnic <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./History_of_Germans_in_Russia_and_the_Soviet_Union\" title=\"History of Germans in Russia and the Soviet Union\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBJo\">Germans</a> from countries of the former Soviet Union make up the largest portion of the Russian-speaking community.<sup about=\"#mwt415\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-97\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-97\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-97\" id=\"mwBJs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBJw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJ0\">[</span>96<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBJ4\">]</span></span></a></sup> The last decade experienced an influx from various Western countries and some African regions.<sup about=\"#mwt418\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-98\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-98\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-98\" id=\"mwBJ8\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBKA\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKE\">[</span>97<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKI\">]</span></span></a></sup> A portion of the African immigrants have settled in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Afrikanisches_Viertel\" title=\"Afrikanisches Viertel\" id=\"mwBKM\">Afrikanisches Viertel</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt421\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-99\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-99\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-99\" id=\"mwBKQ\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBKU\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKY\">[</span>98<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKc\">]</span></span></a></sup> Young Germans, EU-Europeans and Israelis have also settled in the city.<sup about=\"#mwt424\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-100\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-100\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-100\" id=\"mwBKg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBKk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKo\">[</span>99<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBKs\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBKw\">In December 2019 there were 777,345 registered residents of foreign nationality and another 542,975 German citizens with a \"<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Migration_background\" title=\"Migration background\" id=\"mwBK0\">migration background</a>\" <i id=\"mwBK4\">(Migrationshintergrund, MH)</i>,<sup about=\"#mwt425\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg_95-2\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg-95\" id=\"mwBK8\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBLA\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLE\">[</span>94<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLI\">]</span></span></a></sup> meaning they or one of their parents immigrated to Germany after 1955. Foreign residents of Berlin originate from about 190 countries.<sup about=\"#mwt428\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-101\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-101\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-101\" id=\"mwBLM\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBLQ\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLU\">[</span>100<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLY\">]</span></span></a></sup> 48 percent of the residents under the age of 15 have a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Migration_background\" title=\"Migration background\" id=\"mwBLc\">migration background</a> in 2017.<sup about=\"#mwt432\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-102\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-102\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-102\" id=\"mwBLg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBLk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLo\">[</span>101<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBLs\">]</span></span></a></sup> Berlin in 2009 was estimated to have 100,000 to 250,000 unregistered inhabitants.<sup about=\"#mwt435\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-103\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-103\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-103\" id=\"mwBLw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBL0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBL4\">[</span>102<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBL8\">]</span></span></a></sup> Boroughs of Berlin with a significant number of migrants or foreign born population are <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Mitte\" title=\"Mitte\" id=\"mwBMA\">Mitte</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neukölln\" title=\"Neukölln\" id=\"mwBME\">Neukölln</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg\" title=\"Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg\" id=\"mwBMI\">Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt438\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-104\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-104\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-104\" id=\"mwBMM\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBMQ\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBMU\">[</span>103<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBMY\">]</span></span></a></sup> The number of Arabic speakers in Berlin could be higher than 150,000. There are at least 40,000 Berliners with Syrian citizenship, third only behind Turkish and Polish citizens. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./2015_European_migrant_crisis\" title=\"2015 European migrant crisis\" id=\"mwBMc\">2015 refugee crisis</a> made Berlin Europe's capital of Arab culture.<sup about=\"#mwt441\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-105\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-105\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-105\" id=\"mwBMg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBMk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBMo\">[</span>104<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBMs\">]</span></span></a></sup> Berlin is among the cities in Germany that received the biggest amount of refugees after the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./2022_Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine\" title=\"2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine\" id=\"mwBMw\">2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine</a>. As of November 2022, an estimated 85,000 Ukrainian refugees were registered in Berlin,<sup about=\"#mwt444\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-106\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-106\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-106\" id=\"mwBM0\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBM4\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBM8\">[</span>105<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBNA\">]</span></span></a></sup> making Berlin the most popular destination of Ukrainian refugees in Germany.<sup about=\"#mwt447\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-107\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-107\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-107\" id=\"mwBNE\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBNI\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBNM\">[</span>106<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBNQ\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBNU\">Berlin has an active <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Expatriate\" title=\"Expatriate\" id=\"mwBNY\">expatriate</a> community, for instance increasingly students and highly skilled workers from India.<sup about=\"#mwt450\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-108\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-108\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-108\" id=\"mwBNc\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBNg\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBNk\">[</span>107<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBNo\">]</span></span></a></sup> Therefore, Berlin sustains a broad variety of English-based speakers. Speaking a particular type of English does attract prestige and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cultural_capital\" title=\"Cultural capital\" id=\"mwBNs\">cultural capital</a> in Berlin.<sup about=\"#mwt453\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-109\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-109\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-109\" id=\"mwBNw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBN0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBN4\">[</span>108<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBN8\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"16\" id=\"mwBOA\"><h3 id=\"Languages\">Languages</h3>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt454\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBOE\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"German language\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"Berlinerisch dialect\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt455\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt454\" id=\"mwBOI\">Main articles: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./German_language\" title=\"German language\">German language</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlinerisch_dialect\" title=\"Berlinerisch dialect\" class=\"mw-redirect\">Berlinerisch dialect</a></div>\n\n<p id=\"mwBOM\">German is the official and predominant spoken language in Berlin. It is a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./West_Germanic_languages\" title=\"West Germanic languages\" id=\"mwBOQ\">West Germanic language</a> that derives most of its vocabulary from the Germanic branch of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Indo-European_languages\" title=\"Indo-European languages\" id=\"mwBOU\">Indo-European</a> language family. German is one of 24 languages of the European Union,<sup about=\"#mwt458\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-110\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-110\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-110\" id=\"mwBOY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBOc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBOg\">[</span>109<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBOk\">]</span></span></a></sup> and one of the three <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Working_language\" title=\"Working language\" id=\"mwBOo\">working languages</a> of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./European_Commission\" title=\"European Commission\" id=\"mwBOs\">European Commission</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBOw\">Berlinerisch or Berlinisch is not a dialect linguistically. It is spoken in Berlin and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin/Brandenburg_Metropolitan_Region\" title=\"Berlin/Brandenburg Metropolitan Region\" id=\"mwBO0\">surrounding metropolitan area</a>. It originates from a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brandenburgisch_dialect\" title=\"Brandenburgisch dialect\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBO4\">Brandenburgish</a> variant. The dialect is now seen more like a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Sociolect\" title=\"Sociolect\" id=\"mwBO8\">sociolect</a>, largely through increased immigration and trends among the educated population to speak <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Standard_German\" title=\"Standard German\" id=\"mwBPA\">standard German</a> in everyday life.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBPE\">The most commonly spoken foreign languages in Berlin are Turkish, Polish, English, Persian, Arabic, Italian, Bulgarian, Russian, Romanian, Kurdish, Serbo-Croatian, French, Spanish and Vietnamese. Turkish, Arabic, Kurdish, and Serbo-Croatian are heard more often in the western part due to the large Middle Eastern and former-Yugoslavian communities. Polish, English, Russian, and Vietnamese have more native speakers in East Berlin.<sup about=\"#mwt461\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-111\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-111\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-111\" id=\"mwBPI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBPM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBPQ\">[</span>110<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBPU\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section class=\"smooth-pie-border\"></div></div>\n</div></div></div>\n\n<p id=\"mwBP8\">On the report of the 2011 census, approximately 37 percent of the population reported being members of a legally-recognized church or religious organization. The rest either did not belong to such an organization, or there was no information available about them.<sup about=\"#mwt471\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-113\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-113\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-113\" id=\"mwBQA\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBQE\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBQI\">[</span>112<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBQM\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBQQ\">The largest religious denomination recorded in 2010 was the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Protestant\" title=\"Protestant\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBQU\">Protestant</a> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Landeskirche\" title=\"Landeskirche\" id=\"mwBQY\">regional church body</a>—the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Evangelical_Church_of_Berlin-Brandenburg-Silesian_Upper_Lusatia\" title=\"Evangelical Church of Berlin-Brandenburg-Silesian Upper Lusatia\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBQc\">Evangelical Church of Berlin-Brandenburg-Silesian Upper Lusatia (EKBO)</a>—a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./United_church\" title=\"United church\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBQg\">united church</a>. EKBO is a member of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Protestant_Church_in_Germany\" title=\"Protestant Church in Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBQk\">Protestant Church in Germany (EKD)</a> and of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Union_of_Protestant_Churches_in_the_EKD\" title=\"Union of Protestant Churches in the EKD\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBQo\">Union of Protestant Churches in the EKD (UEK)</a>. According to the EKBO, their membership accounted for 19% of the local population, while the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Catholic_Church\" title=\"Catholic Church\" id=\"mwBQs\">Roman Catholic Church</a> had 9% of residents registered as its members.<sup about=\"#mwt474\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-114\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-114\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-114\" id=\"mwBQw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBQ0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBQ4\">[</span>113<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBQ8\">]</span></span></a></sup> About 3% of the population identify with other Christian denominations (mostly <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Eastern_Orthodox_Church\" title=\"Eastern Orthodox Church\" id=\"mwBRA\">Eastern Orthodox</a>, but also various Protestants).<sup about=\"#mwt477\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin–Brandenburg-2010_115-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin–Brandenburg-2010\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin–Brandenburg-2010-115\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin–Brandenburg-2010-115\" id=\"mwBRE\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBRI\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBRM\">[</span>114<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBRQ\">]</span></span></a></sup> According to the Berlin residents register, in 2018 15% were members of the Evangelical Church, and 9% were members of the Catholic Church.<sup about=\"#mwt478\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg_95-3\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg-95\" id=\"mwBRU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBRY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBRc\">[</span>94<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBRg\">]</span></span></a></sup> The government keeps a register of members of these churches for tax purposes, because it collects <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Church_tax#Germany\" title=\"Church tax\" id=\"mwBRk\">church tax</a> on behalf of the churches. It does not keep records of members of other religious organizations which may collect their own church tax, in this way.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBRo\">In 2009, approximately 249,000 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Muslim\" title=\"Muslim\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBRs\">Muslims</a> were reported by the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg\" title=\"Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBRw\">Office of Statistics</a> to be members of mosques and Islamic religious organizations in Berlin,<sup about=\"#mwt481\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-116\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-116\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-116\" id=\"mwBR0\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBR4\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBR8\">[</span>115<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBSA\">]</span></span></a></sup> while in 2016, the newspaper <i id=\"mwBSE\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Der_Tagesspiegel\" title=\"Der Tagesspiegel\" id=\"mwBSI\">Der Tagesspiegel</a></i> estimated that about 350,000 Muslims observed <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Ramadan\" title=\"Ramadan\" id=\"mwBSM\">Ramadan</a> in Berlin.<sup about=\"#mwt482\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Ramadan_117-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Ramadan\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Ramadan-117\" id=\"mwBSQ\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBSU\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBSY\">[</span>116<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBSc\">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2019, about 437,000 registered residents, 12% of the total, reported having a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Migration_background\" title=\"Migration background\" id=\"mwBSg\">migration background</a> from one of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Member_states_of_the_Organization_of_Islamic_Cooperation\" title=\"Member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBSk\">Member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt483\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg_95-4\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin-Brandenburg-95\" id=\"mwBSo\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBSs\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBSw\">[</span>94<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBS0\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt486\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Ramadan_117-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Ramadan\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Ramadan-117\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Ramadan-117\" id=\"mwBS4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBS8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTA\">[</span>116<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTE\">]</span></span></a></sup> Between 1992 and 2011 the Muslim population almost doubled.<sup about=\"#mwt489\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-118\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-118\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-118\" id=\"mwBTI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBTM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTQ\">[</span>117<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTU\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBTY\">About 1% of Berliners belong to other religions. Of the estimated population of 30,000–45,000 Jewish residents,<sup about=\"#mwt492\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-119\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-119\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-119\" id=\"mwBTc\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBTg\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTk\">[</span>118<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBTo\">]</span></span></a></sup> approximately 12,000 are registered members of religious organizations.<sup about=\"#mwt493\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin–Brandenburg-2010_115-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin–Brandenburg-2010\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin–Brandenburg-2010-115\" id=\"mwBTs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBTw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBT0\">[</span>114<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBT4\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBT8\">Berlin is the seat of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Roman_Catholic_Archdiocese_of_Berlin\" title=\"Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBUA\">Roman Catholic archbishop of Berlin</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Evangelical_Church_of_Berlin-Brandenburg-Silesian_Upper_Lusatia\" title=\"Evangelical Church of Berlin-Brandenburg-Silesian Upper Lusatia\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBUE\">EKBO</a>'s elected chairperson is titled the bishop of EKBO. Furthermore, Berlin is the seat of many Orthodox cathedrals, such as the Cathedral of St. Boris the Baptist, one of the two seats of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bulgarian_Orthodox_Church\" title=\"Bulgarian Orthodox Church\" id=\"mwBUI\">Bulgarian Orthodox</a> Diocese of Western and Central Europe, and the Resurrection of Christ Cathedral of the Diocese of Berlin (Patriarchate of Moscow).</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBUM\">The faithful of the different religions and denominations maintain many <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_places_of_worship_in_Berlin\" title=\"List of places of worship in Berlin\" id=\"mwBUQ\">places of worship in Berlin</a>. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Independent_Evangelical_Lutheran_Church\" title=\"Independent Evangelical Lutheran Church\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBUU\">Independent Evangelical Lutheran Church</a> has 8 parishes of different sizes in Berlin.<sup about=\"#mwt496\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-120\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-120\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-120\" id=\"mwBUY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBUc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBUg\">[</span>119<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBUk\">]</span></span></a></sup> There are 36 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Baptist\" title=\"Baptist\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBUo\">Baptist</a> congregations (within <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Union_of_Evangelical_Free_Church_Congregations_in_Germany\" title=\"Union of Evangelical Free Church Congregations in Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBUs\">Union of Evangelical Free Church Congregations in Germany</a>), 29 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./New_Apostolic_Church\" title=\"New Apostolic Church\" id=\"mwBUw\">New Apostolic Churches</a>, 15 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./United_Methodist\" title=\"United Methodist\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBU0\">United Methodist</a> churches, 8 Free Evangelical Congregations, four <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Church_of_Christ,_Scientist\" title=\"Church of Christ, Scientist\" id=\"mwBU4\">Churches of Christ, Scientist</a> (1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 11th), 6 congregations of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./The_Church_of_Jesus_Christ_of_Latter-day_Saints\" title=\"The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints\" id=\"mwBU8\">the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints</a>, an <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Old_Catholic\" title=\"Old Catholic\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBVA\">Old Catholic</a> church, and an <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Anglican\" title=\"Anglican\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBVE\">Anglican</a> church in Berlin. Berlin has more than 80 mosques,<sup about=\"#mwt499\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-121\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-121\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-121\" id=\"mwBVI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBVM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBVQ\">[</span>120<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBVU\">]</span></span></a></sup> 10 synagogues,<sup about=\"#mwt502\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-122\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-122\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-122\" id=\"mwBVY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBVc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBVg\">[</span>121<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBVk\">]</span></span></a></sup> and 2 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Buddhist\" title=\"Buddhist\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBVo\">Buddhist</a> as well as 4 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Hinduism\" title=\"Hinduism\" id=\"mwBVs\">Hindu</a> id=\"mwBYY\"><h2 id=\"Government_and_politics\">Government and politics</h2>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt504\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBYc\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Politics of Berlin\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"Berlin Police\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt505\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt504\" id=\"mwBYg\">Main articles: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Politics_of_Berlin\" title=\"Politics of Berlin\">Politics of Berlin</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Police\" title=\"Berlin Police\">Berlin Police</a></div>\n\n<section data-mw-section-id=\"19\" id=\"mwBYk\"><h3 id=\"City_state\">City state</h3>\n<p id=\"mwBYo\">Since <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./German_reunification\" title=\"German reunification\" id=\"mwBYs\">German reunification</a> on 3 October 1990, Berlin has been one of the three <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./City-states\" title=\"City-states\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBYw\">city-states</a> among the present 16 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./States_of_Germany\" title=\"States of Germany\" id=\"mwBY0\">states of Germany</a>. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Abgeordnetenhaus_von_Berlin\" title=\"Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBY4\">Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin</a> (<i id=\"mwBY8\">House of Representatives</i>) functions as the city and state parliament, which has 141 seats. Berlin's executive body is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Senate_of_Berlin\" title=\"Senate of Berlin\" id=\"mwBZA\">Senate of Berlin</a> (<i id=\"mwBZE\">Senat von Berlin</i>). The Senate consists of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Governing_Mayor_of_Berlin\" title=\"Governing Mayor of Berlin\" id=\"mwBZI\">Governing Mayor of Berlin</a> (<i id=\"mwBZM\">Regierender Bürgermeister</i>), and up to ten senators holding ministerial positions, two of them holding the title of \"Mayor\" (<i id=\"mwBZQ\">Bürgermeister</i>) as deputy to the Governing Mayor.<sup about=\"#mwt508\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-123\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-123\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-123\" id=\"mwBZU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBZY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBZc\">[</span>122<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBZg\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBZk\">The total annual budget of Berlin in 2015 exceeded €24.5 ($30) billion including a budget surplus of €205 ($240) million.<sup about=\"#mwt511\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-124\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-124\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-124\" id=\"mwBZo\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBZs\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBZw\">[</span>123<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBZ0\">]</span></span></a></sup> The state of Berlin owns extensive assets, including administrative and government buildings, real estate companies, as well as stakes in the Olympic Stadium, swimming pools, housing companies, and numerous public enterprises and subsidiary companies.<sup about=\"#mwt514\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-125\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-125\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-125\" id=\"mwBZ4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBZ8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBaA\">[</span>124<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBaE\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt517\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-126\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-126\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-126\" id=\"mwBaI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBaM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBaQ\">[</span>125<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBaU\">]</span></span></a></sup> The state of Berlin runs a real estate portal to advertise commercial spaces or land suitable for redevelopment.<sup about=\"#mwt520\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-127\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-127\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-127\" id=\"mwBaY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBac\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBag\">[</span>126<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBak\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBao\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Social_Democratic_Party_of_Germany\" title=\"Social Democratic Party of Germany\" id=\"mwBas\">Social Democratic Party</a> (SPD) and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./The_Left_(Germany)\" title=\"The Left (Germany)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBaw\">The Left</a> (Die Linke) took control of the city government after the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_state_election,_2001\" title=\"Berlin state election, 2001\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBa0\">2001 state election</a> and won another term in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_state_election,_2006\" title=\"Berlin state election, 2006\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBa4\">2006 state election</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt523\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-128\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-128\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-128\" id=\"mwBa8\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBbA\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBbE\">[</span>127<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBbI\">]</span></span></a></sup> From the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_state_election,_2016\" title=\"Berlin state election, 2016\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBbM\">2016 state election</a> until the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./2023_Berlin_state_election\" title=\"2023 Berlin state election\" id=\"mwBbQ\">2023 state election</a>, there was a coalition between the Social Democratic Party, the Greens and the Left Party. Since April 2023, the government has been formed by a coalition between the Christian Democrats and the Social Democrats.<sup about=\"#mwt526\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Kai_Wegner_zum_Regierenden_Bürgermeister_von_Berlin_gewählt-2023_129-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Kai Wegner zum Regierenden Bürgermeister von Berlin gewählt-2023\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Kai_Wegner_zum_Regierenden_Bürgermeister_von_Berlin_gewählt-2023-129\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Kai_Wegner_zum_Regierenden_Bürgermeister_von_Berlin_gewählt-2023-129\" id=\"mwBbU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBbY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBbc\">[</span>128<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBbg\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBbk\">The Governing Mayor is simultaneously Lord Mayor of the City of Berlin (<i id=\"mwBbo\">Oberbürgermeister der Stadt</i>) and Minister President of the State of Berlin (<i id=\"mwBbs\">Ministerpräsident des Bundeslandes</i>). The office of the Governing Mayor is in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Rotes_Rathaus\" title=\"Rotes Rathaus\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBbw\">Rotes Rathaus (Red City Hall)</a>. Since 2023, this office has been held by <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kai_Wegner\" title=\"Kai Wegner\" id=\"mwBb0\">Kai Wegner</a> of the Christian Democrats.<sup about=\"#mwt527\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Kai_Wegner_zum_Regierenden_Bürgermeister_von_Berlin_gewählt-2023_129-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Kai Wegner zum Regierenden Bürgermeister von Berlin gewählt-2023\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Kai_Wegner_zum_Regierenden_Bürgermeister_von_Berlin_gewählt-2023-129\" id=\"mwBb4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBb8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBcA\">[</span>128<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBcE\">]</span></span></a></sup> He is the first conservative mayor in Berlin in more than two decades.<sup about=\"#mwt530\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-130\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-130\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-130\" id=\"mwBcI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBcM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBcQ\">[</span>129<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBcU\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<ul class=\"gallery mw-gallery-traditional\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/gallery\" about=\"#mwt531\" id=\"mwBcY\"
