data-mw-section-id=\"20\" id=\"mwBdw\"><h3 id=\"Boroughs\">Boroughs</h3>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt532\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBd0\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Boroughs and neighborhoods of Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt533\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt532\" id=\"mwBd4\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Boroughs_and_neighborhoods_of_Berlin\" title=\"Boroughs and neighborhoods of Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\">Boroughs and neighborhoods of Berlin</a></div>\n\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size mw-halign-right\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwBd8\"><a href=\"./File:Berlin_Subdivisions.svg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwBeA\"><img resource=\"./File:Berlin_Subdivisions.svg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Berlin_Subdivisions.svg/330px-Berlin_Subdivisions.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\" srcset=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Berlin_Subdivisions.svg/960px-Berlin_Subdivisions.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x\" data-file-width=\"1400\" data-file-height=\"1151\" data-file-type=\"drawing\" height=\"271\" width=\"330\" class=\"mw-file-element mw-file-upright\" style=\"--mw-file-upright: 1.3\" id=\"mwBeE\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwBeI\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Boroughs_and_neighborhoods_of_Berlin\" title=\"Boroughs and neighborhoods of Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBeM\">Berlin's 12 boroughs and their 96 neighborhoods</a> </figcaption></figure>\n<p id=\"mwBeQ\">Berlin is subdivided into 12 boroughs or districts (<i id=\"mwBeU\">Bezirke</i>). Each borough has several subdistricts or neighborhoods (<i id=\"mwBeY\">Ortsteile</i>), which have roots in much older municipalities that predate the formation of Greater Berlin on 1 October 1920. These subdistricts became urbanized and incorporated into the city later on. Many residents strongly identify with their neighborhoods, colloquially called <i id=\"mwBec\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Kiez\" title=\"Kiez\" id=\"mwBeg\">Kiez</a></i>. At present, Berlin consists of 96 subdistricts<sup about=\"#mwt536\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-131\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-131\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-131\" id=\"mwBek\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBeo\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBes\">[</span>130<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBew\">]</span></span></a></sup>, which are commonly made up of several smaller residential areas or quarters.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBe0\">Each borough is governed by a borough council (<i id=\"mwBe4\">Bezirksamt</i>) consisting of five councilors (<i id=\"mwBe8\">Bezirksstadträte</i>) including the borough's mayor (<i id=\"mwBfA\">Bezirksbürgermeister</i>). The council is elected by the borough assembly (<i id=\"mwBfE\">Bezirksverordnetenversammlung</i>). However, the individual boroughs are not independent municipalities, but subordinate to the Senate of Berlin.<sup about=\"#mwt539\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-132\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-132\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-132\" id=\"mwBfI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBfM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBfQ\">[</span>131<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBfU\">]</span></span></a></sup><!-- ([[urban district]], ''Stadtkreis'') --> The borough's mayors make up the council of mayors (<i id=\"mwBfY\">Rat der Bürgermeister</i>), which is led by the city's Governing Mayor and advises the Senate. The neighborhoods have no local government bodies.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"21\" id=\"mwBfc\"><h3 id=\"City_partnerships\">City partnerships</h3>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt540\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBfg\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main list\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main_list\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"List of twin towns and sister cities in Germany\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt541\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt540\" id=\"mwBfk\">For a more comprehensive list, see <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_twin_towns_and_sister_cities_in_Germany\" title=\"List of twin towns and sister cities in Germany\">List of twin towns and sister cities in Germany</a>.</div>\n\n<p id=\"mwBfo\">Berlin to this day maintains official partnerships with 17 cities.<sup about=\"#mwt544\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-133\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-133\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-133\" id=\"mwBfs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBfw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBf0\">[</span>132<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBf4\">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Sister_city\" title=\"Sister city\" id=\"mwBf8\">Town twinning</a> between <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./West_Berlin\" title=\"West Berlin\" id=\"mwBgA\">West Berlin</a> and other cities began with its sister city Los Angeles, California, in 1967. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./East_Berlin\" title=\"East Berlin\" id=\"mwBgE\">East Berlin</a>'s partnerships were canceled at the time of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./German_reunification\" title=\"German reunification\" id=\"mwBgI\">German reunification</a>.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"22\" id=\"mwBgM\"><h3 id=\"Capital_city\">Capital city</h3>\n<p id=\"mwBgQ\">Berlin is the capital of the Federal Republic of Germany. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./President_of_Germany\" title=\"President of Germany\" id=\"mwBgU\">President of Germany</a>, whose functions are mainly ceremonial under the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Grundgesetz\" title=\"Grundgesetz\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBgY\">German constitution</a>, has their official residence in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bellevue_Palace_(Germany)\" title=\"Bellevue Palace (Germany)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBgc\">Bellevue Palace</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt547\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-134\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-134\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-134\" id=\"mwBgg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBgk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBgo\">[</span>133<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBgs\">]</span></span></a></sup> Berlin is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Seat_of_government\" title=\"Seat of government\" id=\"mwBgw\">seat</a> of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Chancellor_of_Germany_(1949–)\" title=\"Chancellor of Germany (1949–)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBg0\">German Chancellor</a> (Bundeskanzler), housed in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Chancellery_(Berlin)\" title=\"Federal Chancellery (Berlin)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBg4\">Chancellery building</a>, the <i id=\"mwBg8\">Bundeskanzleramt</i>. Facing the Chancellery is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bundestag\" title=\"Bundestag\" id=\"mwBhA\">Bundestag</a>, the German Parliament, housed in the renovated <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Reichstag_building\" title=\"Reichstag building\" id=\"mwBhE\">Reichstag building</a> since the government's relocation to Berlin in 1998. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bundesrat_of_Germany\" title=\"Bundesrat of Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBhI\">Bundesrat</a> (\"federal council\", performing the function of an <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Upper_house\" title=\"Upper house\" id=\"mwBhM\">upper house</a>) is the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federalism\" title=\"Federalism\" id=\"mwBhQ\">representation</a> of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./States_of_Germany\" title=\"States of Germany\" id=\"mwBhU\">16 constituent states</a> (<i id=\"mwBhY\">Länder</i>) of Germany and has its seat at the former <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Prussian_House_of_Lords\" title=\"Prussian House of Lords\" id=\"mwBhc\">Prussian House of Lords</a>. The total annual federal budget managed by the German government exceeded €310 ($375) billion in 2013 <sup about=\"#mwt550\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-135\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-135\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-135\" id=\"mwBhg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBhk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBho\">[</span>134<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBhs\">]</span></span></a></sup> and grew to over €524 ($606) billion in 2026 <sup about=\"#mwt553\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-136\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-136\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-136\" id=\"mwBhw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBh0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBh4\">[</span>135<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBh8\">]</span></span></a></sup>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBiA\">The relocation of the federal <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cabinet_of_Germany\" title=\"Cabinet of Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBiE\">government</a> and Bundestag to Berlin was mostly completed in 1999. However, some ministries, as well as some minor departments, stayed in the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_city\" title=\"Federal city\" id=\"mwBiI\">federal city</a> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bonn\" title=\"Bonn\" id=\"mwBiM\">Bonn</a>, the former capital of West Germany. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin-Bonn_Act\" title=\"Berlin-Bonn Act\" id=\"mwBiQ\">Discussions about moving</a> the remaining ministries and departments to Berlin continue.<sup about=\"#mwt556\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-137\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-137\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-137\" id=\"mwBiU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBiY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBic\">[</span>136<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBig\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBik\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Foreign_Office_(Germany)\" title=\"Foreign Office (Germany)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBio\">Federal Foreign Office</a> and the ministries and departments of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Defence_(Germany)\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)\" id=\"mwBis\">Defense</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Justice_and_Consumer_Protection\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Justice and Consumer Protection\" id=\"mwBiw\">Justice and Consumer Protection</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Finance_(Germany)\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Finance (Germany)\" id=\"mwBi0\">Finance</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_the_Interior_(Germany)\" title=\"Federal Ministry of the Interior (Germany)\" id=\"mwBi4\">Interior</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_for_Economic_Affairs_and_Energy_(Germany)\" title=\"Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (Germany)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBi8\">Economic Affairs and Energy</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Labour_and_Social_Affairs\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs\" id=\"mwBjA\">Labor and Social Affairs</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Family_Affairs,_Senior_Citizens,_Women_and_Youth\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBjE\">Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_the_Environment,_Nature_Conservation_and_Nuclear_Safety\" title=\"Federal Ministry of the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBjI\">Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Health_(Germany)\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Health (Germany)\" id=\"mwBjU\">Health</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Federal_Ministry_of_Transport_and_Digital_Infrastructure\" title=\"Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBjY\">Transport and Digital id=\"mwBjc\">Education and Research</a> are based in the capital.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"23\" id=\"mwBjg\"><h3 id=\"Embassies\">Embassies</h3>\n<p id=\"mwBjk\">Berlin hosts in total 158 foreign <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_diplomatic_missions_in_Germany#Diplomatic_missions_in_Berlin\" title=\"List of diplomatic missions in Germany\" id=\"mwBjo\">embassies</a><sup about=\"#mwt559\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-138\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-138\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-138\" id=\"mwBjs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBjw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBj0\">[</span>137<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBj4\">]</span></span></a></sup> as well as the headquarters of many think tanks, trade unions, nonprofit organizations, lobbying groups, and professional associations. Frequent official visits and diplomatic consultations among governmental representatives and national leaders are common in contemporary Berlin.</p>\n\n</section></section><section data-mw-section-id=\"24\" id=\"mwBj8\"><h2 id=\"Economy\">Economy</h2>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt560\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBkA\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Economy of Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt561\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt560\" id=\"mwBkE\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Economy_of_Berlin\" title=\"Economy of Berlin\">Economy of Berlin</a></div>\n<p id=\"mwBkI\">In 2025, Berlin's GDP amounted to €218.3 billion and grew by 1.1% in real terms from the previous year. Between 2013 and 2025, Berlin's annual real GDP growth exceeded the national rate in every year, with the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Service_sector\" title=\"Service sector\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBkM\">service sector</a> providing the main contribution to growth.<sup about=\"#mwt564\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-139\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-139\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-139\" id=\"mwBkQ\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBkU\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBkY\">[</span>138<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBkc\">]</span></span></a></sup> Berlin's unemployment rate declined from its peak of 18.3% in 2005 to 7.8% in 2019. It rose during the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./COVID-19_pandemic_in_Germany\" title=\"COVID-19 pandemic in Germany\" id=\"mwBkg\">COVID-19 pandemic</a> and, after a temporary decline in 2022, increased to an annual average of 10.3% in 2025.<sup about=\"#mwt567\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-140\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-140\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-140\" id=\"mwBkk\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBko\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBks\">[</span>139<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBkw\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBk0\">Important economic sectors in Berlin include life sciences, transportation, information and communication technologies, media and music, advertising and design, biotechnology, environmental services, construction, e-commerce, retail, hotel business, and medical engineering.<sup about=\"#mwt570\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-141\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-141\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-141\" id=\"mwBk4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBk8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBlA\">[</span>140<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBlE\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBlI\">Research and development have economic significance for the city.<sup about=\"#mwt573\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-berlin.de_142-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./SAP\" title=\"SAP\" id=\"mwBlk\">SAP</a> operate innovation laboratories in the city.<sup about=\"#mwt576\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-143\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-143\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-143\" id=\"mwBlo\"><span rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Charité\" title=\"Charité\" id=\"mwBoE\">Charité</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Vivantes\" title=\"Vivantes\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBoI\">Vivantes</a>, the rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Siemens\" title=\"Siemens\" id=\"mwBoQ\">Siemens</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Telekom\" title=\"Deutsche Telekom\" id=\"mwBoU\">Deutsche Telekom</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt599\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-149\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-149\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-149\" id=\"mwBoY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBoc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBog\">[</span>148<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBok\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBoo\">Siemens, a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Fortune_Global_500\" title=\"Fortune Global 500\" id=\"mwBos\">Global 500</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./DAX\" title=\"DAX\" id=\"mwBow\">DAX</a>-listed company is partly headquartered in Berlin. Other DAX-listed companies headquartered in Berlin are the property company <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Wohnen\" title=\"Deutsche Wohnen\" id=\"mwBo0\">Deutsche Wohnen</a>, the online fashion retailer <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Zalando\" title=\"Zalando\" id=\"mwBo4\">Zalando</a> and the online food delivery service <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Delivery_Hero\" title=\"Delivery Hero\" id=\"mwBo8\">Delivery Hero</a>. The national railway operator <span title=\"German-language text\" about=\"#mwt600\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBpA\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"lang\",\"href\":\"./Template:Lang\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"de\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"[[Deutsche Bahn]]\"},\"italic\":{\"wt\":\"no\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><span lang=\"de\" style=\"font-style: normal;\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Bahn\" title=\"Deutsche Bahn\">Deutsche Bahn</a></span></span><link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:Articles_containing_German-language_text\" about=\"#mwt600\" id=\"mwBpE\"/>,<sup about=\"#mwt603\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-150\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-150\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-150\" id=\"mwBpI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBpM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBpQ\">[</span>149<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBpU\">]</span></span></a></sup> Europe's largest digital publisher<sup about=\"#mwt606\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-151\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-151\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-151\" id=\"mwBpY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBpc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBpg\">[</span>150<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBpk\">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Axel_Springer_SE\" title=\"Axel Springer SE\" id=\"mwBpo\">Axel Springer</a> as well as the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./MDAX\" title=\"MDAX\" id=\"mwBps\">MDAX</a>-listed firm <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./HelloFresh\" title=\"HelloFresh\" id=\"mwBpw\">HelloFresh</a> and also have their main headquarters in the city. Among the largest international corporations who have their German or European headquarters in Berlin are <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bombardier_Transportation\" title=\"Bombardier Transportation\" id=\"mwBp0\">Bombardier Transportation</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Securing_Energy_for_Europe\" title=\"Securing Energy for Europe\" id=\"mwBp4\">Securing Energy for Europe</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Coca-Cola\" title=\"Coca-Cola\" id=\"mwBp8\">Coca-Cola</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Pfizer\" title=\"Pfizer\" id=\"mwBqA\">Pfizer</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Sony\" title=\"Sony\" id=\"mwBqE\">Sony</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./TotalEnergies\" title=\"TotalEnergies\" id=\"mwBqI\">TotalEnergies</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBqM\">As of 2023, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe\" title=\"Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe\" id=\"mwBqQ\">Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe</a>, a network of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Public_bank\" title=\"Public bank\" id=\"mwBqU\">public banks</a> that together form the largest financial services group in Germany and in all of Europe, is headquartered in Berlin. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bundesverband_der_Deutschen_Volksbanken_und_Raiffeisenbanken\" title=\"Bundesverband der Deutschen Volksbanken und Raiffeisenbanken\" id=\"mwBqY\">Bundesverband der Deutschen Volksbanken und Raiffeisenbanken</a> has its headquarters in Berlin, managing around 1.2 trillion euros.<sup about=\"#mwt609\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-152\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-152\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-152\" id=\"mwBqc\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBqg\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBqk\">[</span>151<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBqo\">]</span></span></a></sup> The three largest banks in the capital are <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Kreditbank\" title=\"Deutsche Kreditbank\" id=\"mwBqs\">Deutsche Kreditbank</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Landesbank_Berlin\" title=\"Landesbank Berlin\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBqw\">Landesbank Berlin</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Hyp\" title=\"Berlin Hyp\" id=\"mwBq0\">Berlin Hyp</a>.<sup about=\"#mwt612\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-153\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-153\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-153\" id=\"mwBq4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBq8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBrA\">[</span>152<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBrE\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBrI\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Mercedes-Benz_Group\" title=\"Mercedes-Benz Group\" id=\"mwBrM\">Mercedes-Benz Group</a> manufactures cars, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./BMW_Motorrad\" title=\"BMW Motorrad\" id=\"mwBrQ\">BMW builds motorcycles</a> in Berlin. In 2022, American electric car manufacturer <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Tesla,_Inc.\" title=\"Tesla, Inc.\" id=\"mwBrU\">Tesla</a> opened its first European Gigafactory outside the city borders in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Grünheide_(Mark)\" title=\"Grünheide (Mark)\" id=\"mwBrY\">Grünheide (Mark)</a>, Brandenburg. The Pharmaceuticals division of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bayer\" title=\"Bayer\" id=\"mwBrc\">Bayer</a><sup about=\"#mwt615\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-154\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-154\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-154\" id=\"mwBrg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBrk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBro\">[</span>153<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBrs\">]</span></span></a></sup> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Chemie\" title=\"Berlin Chemie\" id=\"mwBrw\">Berlin Chemie</a> are major pharmaceutical companies in the city.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"26\" id=\"mwBr0\"><h3 tourist attractions in Berlin</a>.</div>\n\n<p id=\"mwBsA\">Berlin had 788 hotels with 134,399 beds in 2014.<sup about=\"#mwt620\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-visitBerlin_155-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"visitBerlin\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-visitBerlin-155\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-visitBerlin-155\" id=\"mwBsE\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBsI\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBsM\">[</span>154<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBsQ\">]</span></span></a></sup> The city recorded 28.7<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwBsU\"> </span>million overnight hotel stays and 11.9<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwBsY\"> </span>million hotel guests in 2014.<sup about=\"#mwt621\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-visitBerlin_155-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"visitBerlin\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-visitBerlin-155\" id=\"mwBsc\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBsg\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBsk\">[</span>154<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBso\">]</span></span></a></sup> Tourism figures have more than doubled within the last ten years and Berlin has become the 3rd-most-visited city destination in Europe. Some of the most visited places in Berlin include: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Potsdamer_Platz\" title=\"Potsdamer Platz\" id=\"mwBss\">Potsdamer Platz</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brandenburg_Gate\" title=\"Brandenburg Gate\" id=\"mwBsw\">Brandenburger Tor</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Wall\" title=\"Berlin Wall\" id=\"mwBs0\">the Berlin wall</a>, <a id=\"mwBs8\">Museumsinsel</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Fernsehturm_Berlin\" title=\"Fernsehturm Berlin\" id=\"mwBtA\">Fernsehturm</a>, the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./East_Side_Gallery\" rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Victory_Column\" title=\"Berlin Victory Column\" id=\"mwBtQ\">Siegessäule</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Gedenkstätte_Berliner_Mauer\" title=\"Gedenkstätte id=\"mwBto\">Holocaust-Mahnmal</a>. The largest visitor groups are from Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain and the United States.<sup about=\"#mwt624\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-156\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-156\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-156\" id=\"mwBts\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBtw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBt0\">[</span>155<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBt4\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBt8\">According to figures from the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./International_Congress_and_Convention_Association\" title=\"International Congress and Convention Association\" id=\"mwBuA\">International Congress and Convention Association</a> in 2015, Berlin became the leading organizer of conferences globally, hosting 195 international meetings.<sup about=\"#mwt627\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-157\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-157\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-157\" id=\"mwBuE\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBuI\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBuM\">[</span>156<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBuQ\">]</span></span></a></sup> Some of these congress events take place on venues such as CityCube Berlin or the Berlin Congress Center (bcc).</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwBuU\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Messe_Berlin\" title=\"Messe Berlin\" id=\"mwBuY\">Messe Berlin</a> (also known as Berlin ExpoCenter City) is the main convention organizing company in the city. Its main exhibition area covers more than <span about=\"#mwt628\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBuc\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"convert\",\"href\":\"./Template:Convert\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"160000\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"m2\"},\"3\":{\"wt\":\"0\"},\"sp\":{\"wt\":\"us\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'>160,000 square meters (1,722,226</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt628\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt628\">sq</span><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" about=\"#mwt628\"> </span><span about=\"#mwt628\">ft)</span>. Several large-scale trade fairs like the consumer electronics trade fair <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./IFA_Berlin\" title=\"IFA Berlin\" id=\"mwBug\">IFA</a>, where the first practical audio <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Magnetophon\" title=\"Magnetophon\" id=\"mwBuk\">tape recorder</a> and the first <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Manfred_von_Ardenne\" title=\"Manfred von Ardenne\" rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./European_Film_Academy\" title=\"European Film Academy\" id=\"mwBxE\">European Film Academy</a> (logo pictured) was founded in Berlin.</figcaption></figure>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwBxI\"><a href=\"./File:Postfuhramt_(Berlin)_-msu-2021-4274-.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwBxM\"><img resource=\"./File:Postfuhramt_(Berlin)_-msu-2021-4274-.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/28/Postfuhramt_%28Berlin%29_-msu-2021-4274-.jpg/250px-Postfuhramt_%28Berlin%29_-msu-2021-4274-.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Postfuhramt\" title=\"Postfuhramt\" id=\"mwBxY\">Postfuhramt</a> in Berlin-Mitte, where <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Ottomar_Anschütz\" title=\"Ottomar Anschütz\" id=\"mwBxc\">Ottomar Anschütz</a> held the first showing of life sized pictures in motion on 25 November 1894<sup about=\"#mwt650\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-163\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-163\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-163\" id=\"mwBxg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBxk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBxo\">[</span>162<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBxs\">]</span></span></a></sup></figcaption></figure>\n\n<p id=\"mwBxw\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Creative_industries\" title=\"Creative industries\" id=\"mwBx0\">creative arts and entertainment</a> business is an important part of Berlin's economy. The sector comprises music, film, advertising, architecture, art, design, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./German_fashion\" title=\"German fashion\" id=\"mwBx4\">fashion</a>, performing arts, publishing, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Research_and_development\" title=\"Research and development\" id=\"mwBx8\">R&amp;D</a>, software,<sup about=\"#mwt653\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-164\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-164\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-164\" id=\"mwByA\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwByE\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwByI\">[</span>163<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwByM\">]</span></span></a></sup> TV, radio, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Video_gaming_in_Germany\" title=\"Video gaming in Germany\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwByQ\">video games</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwByU\">In 2014, around 30,500 creative companies operated in the Berlin-Brandenburg metropolitan region, predominantly <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Small_and_medium-sized_enterprises\" title=\"Small and medium-sized enterprises\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwByY\">SMEs</a>. Generating a revenue of 15.6<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwByc\"> </span>billion Euro and 6% of all private economic sales, the culture industry grew from 2009 to 2014 at an average rate of 5.5% per year.<sup about=\"#mwt656\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-165\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-165\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-165\" id=\"mwByg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwByk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwByo\">[</span>164<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBys\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwByw\">Berlin is an important European and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cinema_of_Germany\" title=\"Cinema of Germany\" id=\"mwBy0\">German film industry</a> hub.<sup about=\"#mwt659\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-166\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-166\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-166\" id=\"mwBy4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBy8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBzA\">[</span>165<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBzE\">]</span></span></a></sup> It is home to more than 1,000 film and television production companies, 270 movie theaters, and around 300 national and international co-productions are filmed in the region every year.<sup about=\"#mwt660\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-berlin.de_142-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"berlin.de\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-berlin.de-142\" id=\"mwBzI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwBzM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBzQ\">[</span>141<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwBzU\">]</span></span></a></sup> The historic <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Babelsberg_Studios\" title=\"Babelsberg Studios\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBzY\">Babelsberg Studios</a> and the production company <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Universum_Film_AG\" title=\"Universum Film AG\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwBzc\">UFA</a> are adjacent to Berlin in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Potsdam\" title=\"Potsdam\" id=\"mwBzg\">Potsdam</a>. The city is also home of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Filmakademie\" title=\"Deutsche Filmakademie\" id=\"mwBzk\">German Film Academy</a> (Deutsche Filmakademie), founded in 2003, and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./European_Film_Academy\" title=\"European Film Academy\" id=\"mwBzo\">European Film Academy</a>, founded in 1988.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"28\" id=\"mwBzs\"><h3 id=\"Media\">Media</h3>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt661\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBzw\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Media in Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt662\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt661\" id=\"mwBz0\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Media_in_Berlin\" title=\"Media in Berlin\">Media in Berlin</a></div>\n\n<p id=\"mwBz4\">Berlin is home to many magazine, newspaper, book, and scientific/academic publishers and their associated service industries. In addition, around 20 news agencies, more than 90 regional daily newspapers and their websites, as well as the Berlin offices of more than 22 national publications such as <span title=\"German-language text\" about=\"#mwt663\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwBz8\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Lang\",\"href\":\"./Template:Lang\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"de\"},\"2\":{\"wt\":\"[[Der Spiegel]]\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><i lang=\"de\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Der_Spiegel\" title=\"Der Spiegel\">Der Spiegel</a></i></span><link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:Articles_containing_German-language_text\" about=\"#mwt663\" id=\"mwB0A\"/>, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Die_Zeit\" title=\"Die Zeit\" id=\"mwB0E\">Die Zeit</a> reinforce the capital's position as Germany's epicenter for influential debate. Therefore, many international journalists, bloggers, and writers live and work in the city.<link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:All_articles_with_unsourced_statements\" about=\"#mwt664\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwB0I\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Citation needed\",\"href\":\"./Template:Citation_needed\"},\"params\":{\"date\":{\"wt\":\"May 2024\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'/><link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:Articles_with_unsourced_statements_from_May_2024\" about=\"#mwt664\"/><sup class=\"noprint Inline-Template Template-Fact\" style=\"white-space:nowrap;\" about=\"#mwt664\" id=\"mwB0M\"><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">[</span><i><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Wikipedia:Citation_needed\" title=\"Wikipedia:Citation needed\"><span title=\"This claim needs references to reliable sources. (May 2024)\">citation needed</span></a></i><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">]</span></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB0Q\">Berlin is the central location to several international and regional television and radio stations.<sup about=\"#mwt667\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-167\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-167\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-167\" id=\"mwB0U\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB0Y\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB0c\">[</span>166<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB0g\">]</span></span></a></sup> The public broadcaster <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Rundfunk_Berlin-Brandenburg\" title=\"Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg\" id=\"mwB0k\">RBB</a> has its headquarters in Berlin as well as the commercial broadcasters <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./MTV_Europe\" title=\"MTV Europe\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB0o\">MTV Europe</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Welt_(German_TV_channel)\" title=\"Welt (German TV channel)\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB0s\">Welt</a>. German international public broadcaster <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Welle\" title=\"Deutsche Welle\" id=\"mwB0w\">Deutsche Welle</a> has its TV production unit in Berlin, and most national German broadcasters have a studio in the city, including <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./ZDF\" title=\"ZDF\" id=\"mwB00\">ZDF</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./RTL_Television\" title=\"RTL Television\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB04\">RTL</a>.</p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB08\">Berlin has Germany's largest number of daily newspapers, with numerous local <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Broadsheet\" title=\"Broadsheet\" id=\"mwB1A\">broadsheets</a> (<i id=\"mwB1E\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berliner_Morgenpost\" title=\"Berliner Morgenpost\" id=\"mwB1I\">Berliner Morgenpost</a></i>, <i id=\"mwB1M\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berliner_Zeitung\" title=\"Berliner Zeitung\" id=\"mwB1Q\">Berliner Zeitung</a></i>, <i id=\"mwB1U\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Der_Tagesspiegel\" title=\"Der Tagesspiegel\" id=\"mwB1Y\">Der Tagesspiegel</a></i>), and three major <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Tabloid_(newspaper_format)\" title=\"Tabloid (newspaper format)\" id=\"mwB1c\">tabloids</a>, as well as national dailies of varying sizes, each with a different political affiliation, such as <i id=\"mwB1g\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Die_Welt\" title=\"Die Welt\" id=\"mwB1k\">Die Welt</a></i>, <i id=\"mwB1o\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Neues_Deutschland\" title=\"Neues Deutschland\" id=\"mwB1s\">Neues Deutschland</a></i>, and <i id=\"mwB1w\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Die_Tageszeitung\" title=\"Die Tageszeitung\" id=\"mwB10\">Die Tageszeitung</a></i>. <i id=\"mwB14\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./The_Berliner_(magazine)\" title=\"The Berliner (magazine)\" id=\"mwB18\">The Berliner</a></i>, a monthly magazine, is Berlin's English-language periodical and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./La_Gazette_de_Berlin\" title=\"La Gazette de Berlin\" id=\"mwB2A\">La Gazette de Berlin</a> a French-language newspaper.<link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:All_articles_with_unsourced_statements\" about=\"#mwt668\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwB2E\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Citation needed\",\"href\":\"./Template:Citation_needed\"},\"params\":{\"date\":{\"wt\":\"May 2024\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'/><link rel=\"mw:PageProp/Category\" href=\"./Category:Articles_with_unsourced_statements_from_May_2024\" about=\"#mwt668\"/><sup class=\"noprint Inline-Template Template-Fact\" style=\"white-space:nowrap;\" about=\"#mwt668\" id=\"mwB2I\"><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">[</span><i><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Wikipedia:Citation_needed\" title=\"Wikipedia:Citation needed\"><span title=\"This claim needs references to reliable sources. (May 2024)\">citation needed</span></a></i><span typeof=\"mw:Entity\">]</span></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB2M\">Berlin is also home to several major German-language publishing houses, including <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Walter_de_Gruyter\" title=\"Walter de Gruyter\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB2Q\">Walter de Gruyter</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Axel_Springer_AG\" title=\"Axel Springer AG\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB2U\">Springer</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Suhrkamp\" title=\"Suhrkamp\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB2Y\">Suhrkamp</a>, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cornelsen_Verlag\" title=\"Cornelsen Verlag\" id=\"mwB2c\">Cornelsen</a>.</p>\n\n</section></section><section data-mw-section-id=\"29\" id=\"mwB2g\"><h2 id=\"Quality_of_life\">Quality of life</h2>\n<p id=\"mwB2k\">In a 2023 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./European_Commission\" title=\"European Commission\" id=\"mwB2o\">European Commission</a> survey, 86% of respondents in Berlin were satisfied with the city as a place to live. The survey also found that 83% were satisfied with their personal job situation.<sup about=\"#mwt671\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-168\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-168\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-168\" id=\"mwB2s\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB2w\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB20\">[</span>167<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB24\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB28\">In the 2025 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Global_city#Global_Power_City_Index\" title=\"Global city\" id=\"mwB3A\">Global Power City Index</a>, Berlin ranked fourth in the livability category among 48 cities. The category covers working conditions, the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cost_of_living\" title=\"Cost of living\" id=\"mwB3E\">cost of living</a>, safety, health and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Well-being\" title=\"Well-being\" id=\"mwB3I\">well-being</a>, and access to everyday services and amenities.<sup about=\"#mwt674\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-169\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-169\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-169\" id=\"mwB3M\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB3Q\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB3U\">[</span>168<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB3Y\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB3c\">Berlin's 2025 Social Report, which covers developments through 2023, found that around 20% of residents were <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Poverty_threshold\" title=\"Poverty threshold\" id=\"mwB3g\">at risk of poverty</a>. It also found that a similar share of households spent at least 40% of their income on rent and associated charges.<sup about=\"#mwt677\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-170\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-170\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-170\" id=\"mwB3k\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB3o\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB3s\">[</span>169<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB3w\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"30\" id=\"mwB30\"><h2 id=\"Transport\">Transport</h2>\n<span class=\"mw-empty-elt\" about=\"#mwt678\" typeof=\"mw:Transclusion\" id=\"mwB34\" data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Transport in Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" href=\"mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237\" about=\"#mwt679\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/templatestyles\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"templatestyles\",\"attrs\":{\"src\":\"Module:Hatnote/styles.css\"},\"body\":{\"extsrc\":\"\"}}'/></span><div role=\"note\" class=\"hatnote navigation-not-searchable\" about=\"#mwt678\" id=\"mwB38\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Transport_in_Berlin\" title=\"Transport in Berlin\">Transport in Berlin</a></div>\n\n<section data-mw-section-id=\"31\" id=\"mwB4A\"><h3 id=\"Airports\">Airports</h3>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size mw-halign-right\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwB4E\"><a href=\"./File:Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwB4I\"><img resource=\"./File:Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/80/Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg/250px-Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\" srcset=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/80/Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg/500px-Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport_at_night.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x\" data-file-width=\"6090\" data-file-height=\"3117\" data-file-type=\"bitmap\" height=\"128\" width=\"250\" class=\"mw-file-element\" id=\"mwB4M\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwB4Q\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport\" title=\"Berlin Brandenburg Airport\" id=\"mwB4U\">Berlin Brandenburg Airport</a> (BER) at night</figcaption></figure><p id=\"mwB4Y\">Berlin is served by <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Brandenburg_Airport\" title=\"Berlin Brandenburg Airport\" id=\"mwB4c\">Berlin Brandenburg Airport</a> (BER), an international airport in <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Schönefeld\" title=\"Schönefeld\" id=\"mwB4g\">Schönefeld</a>, Brandenburg, located just outside Berlin's south-eastern border. Construction began in 2006, and the airport opened in October 2020 after extensive delays and cost overruns, consolidating commercial air traffic from <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Tegel_Airport\" title=\"Berlin Tegel Airport\" id=\"mwB4k\">Tegel Airport</a> and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Schönefeld_Airport\" title=\"Berlin Schönefeld Airport\" id=\"mwB4o\">Schönefeld Airport</a> at a single site.<sup about=\"#mwt682\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-171\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-171\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-171\" id=\"mwB4s\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB4w\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB40\">[</span>170<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB44\">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about=\"#mwt685\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-172\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-172\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-172\" id=\"mwB48\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB5A\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5E\">[</span>171<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5I\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB5M\">In 2025, BER handled 26.1 million passengers and was Germany's third-busiest airport.<sup about=\"#mwt688\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-173\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-173\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-173\" id=\"mwB5Q\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB5U\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5Y\">[</span>172<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5c\">]</span></span></a></sup> The airport can be further expanded to accommodate up to 55 million passengers annually by 2040.<sup about=\"#mwt691\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-174\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-174\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-174\" id=\"mwB5g\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB5k\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5o\">[</span>173<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB5s\">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./BER_Airport_station\" title=\"BER Airport station\" id=\"mwB5w\">BER Airport station</a>, located beneath Terminal 1, is served by the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_S-Bahn\" title=\"Berlin S-Bahn\" id=\"mwB50\">Berlin S-Bahn</a>, regional and long-distance trains, and the Airport Express (FEX). Since December 2025, the FEX has connected the airport with <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Hauptbahnhof\" title=\"Berlin Hauptbahnhof\" id=\"mwB54\">Berlin Hauptbahnhof</a> in approximately 23 minutes.<sup about=\"#mwt694\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-175\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-175\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-175\" id=\"mwB58\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB6A\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB6E\">[</span>174<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB6I\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB6M\">Until its closure in 2008, Berlin was also served by <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Tempelhof_Airport\" title=\"Berlin Tempelhof Airport\" id=\"mwB6Q\">Tempelhof Airport</a>. Its former airfield opened as the public park <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Tempelhofer_Feld\" title=\"Tempelhofer Feld\" id=\"mwB6U\">Tempelhofer Feld</a> in 2010.<sup about=\"#mwt697\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-176\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-176\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-176\" id=\"mwB6Y\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB6c\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB6g\">[</span>175<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB6k\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"32\" id=\"mwB6o\"><h3 id=\"Roads\">Roads</h3>\n<p id=\"mwB6s\">Berlin's transport infrastructure provides a diverse range of urban mobility.<sup about=\"#mwt700\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-177\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-177\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-177\" id=\"mwB6w\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB60\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB64\">[</span>176<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB68\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwB7A\">A total of 979 bridges cross 197<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwB7E\"> </span>km (122 miles) the inner-city waterways. Berlin roads total 5,422<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwB7I\"> </span>km (3,369 miles) of which 77<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwB7M\"> </span>km (48 miles) are motorways (known as <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Autobahn\" title=\"Autobahn\" id=\"mwB7Q\">Autobahn</a>).<sup about=\"#mwt701\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin_Brandenburg_178-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin Brandenburg\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin_Brandenburg-178\" id=\"mwB7U\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB7Y\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB7c\">[</span>177<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB7g\">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2013 only 1.344 million motor vehicles were registered in the city.<sup about=\"#mwt704\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin_Brandenburg_178-1\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Amt für Statistik Berlin Brandenburg\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin_Brandenburg-178\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Amt_für_Statistik_Berlin_Brandenburg-178\" id=\"mwB7k\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB7o\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB7s\">[</span>177<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB7w\">]</span></span></a></sup> With 377 cars per 1000 residents in 2013 (570/1000 in Germany), Berlin as a Western global city has one of the lowest numbers of cars per capita.<sup about=\"#mwt707\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-179\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-179\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-179\" id=\"mwB70\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB74\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB78\">[</span>178<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB8A\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"33\" id=\"mwB8E\"><h3 id=\"Rail\">Rail</h3>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size mw-halign-right\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwB8I\"><a href=\"./File:Train_station_Berlin_Potsdamer_Platz.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwB8M\"><img resource=\"./File:Train_station_Berlin_Potsdamer_Platz.jpg\" href=\"./Deutsche_Bahn\" title=\"Deutsche Bahn\" id=\"mwB8Y\">DB</a> <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Potsdamer_Platz_station\" title=\"Berlin Potsdamer Platz station\" id=\"mwB8c\">Station Potsdamer Platz</a></figcaption></figure>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size mw-halign-right\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwB8g\"><a href=\"./File:Berlin_Hauptbahnhof0514.JPG\" 2x\" data-file-width=\"3775\" data-file-height=\"2178\" data-file-type=\"bitmap\" height=\"144\" width=\"250\" class=\"mw-file-element\" id=\"mwB8o\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwB8s\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Hauptbahnhof\" title=\"Berlin Hauptbahnhof\" id=\"mwB8w\">Berlin Hauptbahnhof</a> (Berlin Central Station)</figcaption></figure>\n\n<p id=\"mwB80\">Long-distance rail lines directly connect Berlin with all of the major cities of Germany. The regional rail lines of the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Verkehrsverbund_Berlin-Brandenburg\" title=\"Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg\" id=\"mwB84\">Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg</a> provide access to <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brandenburg\" title=\"Brandenburg\" id=\"mwB88\">Brandenburg</a> and to the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Baltic_Sea\" title=\"Baltic Sea\" id=\"mwB9A\">Baltic Sea</a>. The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_Hauptbahnhof\" title=\"Berlin Hauptbahnhof\" id=\"mwB9E\">Berlin Hauptbahnhof</a> (Berlin Central Station) is the largest <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Grade_separation\" title=\"Grade separation\" id=\"mwB9I\">grade-separated</a> railway station in Europe.<sup about=\"#mwt710\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-180\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-180\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-180\" id=\"mwB9M\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB9Q\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB9U\">[</span>179<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB9Y\">]</span></span></a></sup> The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Deutsche_Bahn\" title=\"Deutsche Bahn\" id=\"mwB9c\">Deutsche Bahn</a> runs the high speed <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Intercity-Express\" title=\"Intercity-Express\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB9g\">Intercity-Express</a> (ICE) to domestic destinations, including <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Hamburg\" title=\"Hamburg\" id=\"mwB9k\">Hamburg</a>, Munich, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cologne\" title=\"Cologne\" id=\"mwB9o\">Cologne</a>, <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Stuttgart\" title=\"Stuttgart\" id=\"mwB9s\">Stuttgart</a>, and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Frankfurt_am_Main\" title=\"Frankfurt am Main\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwB9w\">Frankfurt am Main</a>.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"34\" id=\"mwB90\"><h3 id=\"Water_transport\">Water transport</h3>\n<p id=\"mwB94\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Spree_(river)\" title=\"Spree (river)\" id=\"mwB98\">Spree</a> and the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Havel\" title=\"Havel\" id=\"mwB-A\">Havel</a> rivers cross Berlin. There are no frequent passenger connections to and from Berlin by water. Berlin's largest inland port, the <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Westhafen\" title=\"Westhafen\" id=\"mwB-E\">Westhafen</a>, is located in the district of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Moabit\" title=\"Moabit\" id=\"mwB-I\">Moabit</a>. It is a transhipment and storage site for inland shipping with a growing importance.<sup about=\"#mwt713\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-181\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-181\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-181\" id=\"mwB-M\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB-Q\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB-U\">[</span>180<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB-Y\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"35\" id=\"mwB-c\"><h3 id=\"Intercity_buses\">Intercity buses</h3>\n<p id=\"mwB-g\">There is an increasing quantity of <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Intercity_bus_service\" title=\"Intercity bus service\" id=\"mwB-k\">intercity bus services</a>. Berlin city has more than 10 stations<sup about=\"#mwt716\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-182\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-182\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-182\" id=\"mwB-o\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwB-s\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB-w\">[</span>181<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwB-0\">]</span></span></a></sup> that run buses to destinations throughout Berlin. Destinations in Germany and Europe are connected via the intercity bus exchange <i id=\"mwB-4\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Zentraler_Omnibusbahnhof_Berlin\" title=\"Zentraler Omnibusbahnhof Berlin\" id=\"mwB-8\">Zentraler Omnibusbahnhof Berlin</a></i>.</p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"36\" id=\"mwB_A\"><h3 id=\"Urban_public_transport\">Urban public transport</h3>\n<figure 20th-century division of the city, where movement between the two halves was not served. Since 1989, the transport network has been developed extensively. However, it still contains early 20th century trains, such as the U1.<sup about=\"#mwt729\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-184\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-184\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-184\" id=\"mwCDM\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCDQ\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCDU\">[</span>183<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCDY\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"37\" id=\"mwCDc\"><h3 data-mw='{\"parts\":[{\"template\":{\"target\":{\"wt\":\"Main\",\"href\":\"./Template:Main\"},\"params\":{\"1\":{\"wt\":\"Cycling in Berlin\"}},\"i\":0}}]}'><link rel=\"mw-deduplicated-inline-style\" about=\"#mwt730\" id=\"mwCDk\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cycling_in_Berlin\" title=\"Cycling in Berlin\">Cycling in Berlin</a></div>\n\n<p id=\"mwCDo\">Berlin is well known for its highly developed <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Bicycle_lane\" title=\"Bicycle lane\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwCDs\">bicycle lane</a> system.<sup about=\"#mwt734\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-185\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-185\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-185\" id=\"mwCDw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCD0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCD4\">[</span>184<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCD8\">]</span></span></a></sup> It is estimated that Berlin has 710 bicycles per 1,000 residents. Around 500,000 daily bike riders accounted for 13% of total traffic in 2010.<sup about=\"#mwt737\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-186\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-186\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-186\" id=\"mwCEA\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCEE\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCEI\">[</span>185<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCEM\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwCEQ\">Cyclists in Berlin have access to 620<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEU\"> </span>km of bicycle paths including approximately 150<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEY\"> </span>km of mandatory bicycle paths, 190<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEc\"> </span>km of off-road bicycle routes, 60<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEg\"> </span>km of bicycle lanes on roads, 70<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEk\"> </span>km of shared bus lanes which are also open to cyclists, 100<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEo\"> </span>km of combined pedestrian/bike paths and 50<span typeof=\"mw:Entity\" id=\"mwCEs\"> </span>km of marked bicycle lanes on roadside pavements or sidewalks.<sup about=\"#mwt740\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-187\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-187\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-187\" id=\"mwCEw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCE0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCE4\">[</span>186<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCE8\">]</span></span></a></sup> Riders are allowed to carry their bicycles on <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Regionalbahn\" title=\"Regionalbahn\" id=\"mwCFA\">Regionalbahn</a> (RE), S-Bahn and U-Bahn trains, on trams, and on night buses if a bike ticket is purchased.<sup about=\"#mwt743\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-188\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-188\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-188\" id=\"mwCFE\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCFI\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCFM\">[</span>187<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCFQ\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"38\" id=\"mwCFU\"><h3 id=\"Taxicabs\">Taxicabs</h3>\n<p id=\"mwCFY\">Taxicabs in Berlin are yellow or beige. In 2024, around 8,000 <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Taxicabs\" title=\"Taxicabs\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwCFc\">taxicabs</a> were in service.<sup about=\"#mwt746\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-189\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-189\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-189\" id=\"mwCFg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCFk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCFo\">[</span>188<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCFs\">]</span></span></a></sup> Like in most of Europe, app-based <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Ridesharing_company\" title=\"Ridesharing company\" id=\"mwCFw\">sharing cab services</a> are available but limited.<sup about=\"#mwt749\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-190\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-190\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-190\" id=\"mwCF0\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCF4\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCF8\">[</span>189<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCGA\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section></section><section data-mw-section-id=\"39\" id=\"mwCGE\"><h2 id=\"Energy\">Energy</h2>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwCGI\"><a href=\"./File:Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwCGM\"><img resource=\"./File:Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/69/Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg/250px-Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\" srcset=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/69/Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg/500px-Berlin-mitte_heizkraftwerk-mitte_20060605_629.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x\" data-file-width=\"2304\" data-file-height=\"1728\" data-file-type=\"bitmap\" height=\"188\" width=\"250\" class=\"mw-file-element\" id=\"mwCGQ\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwCGU\">Heizkraftwerk Mitte power plant</figcaption></figure>\n\n<p id=\"mwCGY\">Most of the electricity generated in Berlin comes from <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Cogeneration\" title=\"Cogeneration\" id=\"mwCGc\">combined heat and power</a> (CHP) plants, which also supply the city's <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./District_heating\" title=\"District heating\" id=\"mwCGg\">district heating</a> networks. Berlin is a net importer of electricity and draws power from neighboring <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Brandenburg\" title=\"Brandenburg\" id=\"mwCGk\">Brandenburg</a>, particularly during summer, when local CHP plants operate at reduced output.<sup about=\"#mwt752\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Berlin-electricity-2024_191-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Berlin-electricity-2024\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Berlin-electricity-2024-191\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Berlin-electricity-2024-191\" id=\"mwCGo\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCGs\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCGw\">[</span>190<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCG0\">]</span></span></a></sup></p> \n\n<p id=\"mwCG4\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Berlin_380-kV_electric_line\" title=\"Berlin 380-kV electric line\" id=\"mwCG8\">Berlin 380-kV electric line</a>, which crosses the city from Spandau to Marzahn, forms a central part of the city's transmission network.<sup about=\"#mwt755\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-192\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-192\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-192\" id=\"mwCHA\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCHE\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCHI\">[</span>191<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCHM\">]</span></span></a></sup> Its connection to the regional grid in 1994 ended <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./West_Berlin\" title=\"West Berlin\" id=\"mwCHQ\">West Berlin</a>'s operation as a power island.<sup about=\"#mwt758\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-193\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-193\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-193\" id=\"mwCHU\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCHY\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCHc\">[</span>192<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCHg\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwCHk\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./BEW_Berliner_Energie_und_Wärme?action=edit&amp;redlink=1\" title=\"BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme\" class=\"new\" typeof=\"mw:LocalizedAttrs\" id=\"mwCHo\" data-mw-i18n='{\"title\":{\"lang\":\"x-page\",\"key\":\"red-link-title\",\"params\":[\"BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme\"]}}'>BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme</a>, owned by the state of Berlin since 2024, operates several major CHP plants and the city's largest district heating network, which supplies about one third of Berlin's households.<sup about=\"#mwt761\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-BEW-public-ownership_194-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"BEW-public-ownership\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-BEW-public-ownership-194\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-BEW-public-ownership-194\" id=\"mwCHs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCHw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCH0\">[</span>193<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCH4\">]</span></span></a></sup> Its largest plants are the coal-fired Reuter West power station and the natural gas-fired Berlin-Mitte power station.<sup about=\"#mwt764\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-BEW-generating-facilities_195-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"BEW-generating-facilities\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-BEW-generating-facilities-195\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-BEW-generating-facilities-195\" id=\"mwCH8\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCIA\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCIE\">[</span>194<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCII\">]</span></span></a></sup></p> \n\n<p id=\"mwCIM\">Electricity generation from <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Renewable_energy\" title=\"Renewable energy\" id=\"mwCIQ\">renewable sources</a> in the city is growing, driven particularly by <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Photovoltaics\" title=\"Photovoltaics\" id=\"mwCIU\">photovoltaics</a>. By the end of 2025, Berlin had 55,861 photovoltaic installations with a combined capacity of 487 MWp. Their estimated annual generation was about 438 GWh, equivalent to approximately 6% of Berlin’s gross electricity generation.<sup about=\"#mwt767\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-196\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-196\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-196\" id=\"mwCIY\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCIc\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCIg\">[</span>195<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCIk\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwCIo\">Berlin's climate legislation requires the Senate to work toward a <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Coal_phase-out\" title=\"Coal phase-out\" id=\"mwCIs\">phase-out of hard coal</a> by 2030.<sup about=\"#mwt770\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Berlin-coal-phase-out_197-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Berlin-coal-phase-out\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Berlin-coal-phase-out-197\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Berlin-coal-phase-out-197\" id=\"mwCIw\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCI0\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCI4\">[</span>196<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCI8\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"40\" id=\"mwCJA\"><h2 id=\"Health\">Health</h2>\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwCJE\"><a href=\"./File:Charité_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwCJI\"><img resource=\"./File:Charité_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2c/Charit%C3%A9_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg/250px-Charit%C3%A9_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\" srcset=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2c/Charit%C3%A9_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg/500px-Charit%C3%A9_vom_Futurium_aus.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x\" data-file-width=\"3264\" data-file-height=\"1836\" data-file-type=\"bitmap\" height=\"141\" width=\"250\" class=\"mw-file-element\" id=\"mwCJM\"/></a><figcaption id=\"mwCJQ\"><a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Charité\" title=\"Charité\" id=\"mwCJU\">Charité</a>, Europe's <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./List_of_hospitals_by_capacity\" title=\"List of hospitals by capacity\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwCJY\">largest university hospital</a></figcaption></figure>\n<p id=\"mwCJc\">Berlin has a long history of discoveries in medicine and innovations in medical technology.<sup about=\"#mwt773\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-198\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-198\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-198\" id=\"mwCJg\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCJk\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCJo\">[</span>197<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCJs\">]</span></span></a></sup> The modern history of medicine has been significantly influenced by scientists from Berlin. <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Rudolf_Virchow\" title=\"Rudolf Virchow\" id=\"mwCJw\">Rudolf Virchow</a> was the founder of cellular pathology, while <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Robert_Koch\" title=\"Robert Koch\" id=\"mwCJ0\">Robert Koch</a> developed vaccines for anthrax, cholera, and tuberculosis.<sup about=\"#mwt776\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-199\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-199\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-199\" id=\"mwCJ4\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCJ8\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCKA\">[</span>198<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCKE\">]</span></span></a></sup> For his life's work Koch is seen as one of the founders of modern medicine.<sup about=\"#mwt779\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-200\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-200\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-200\" id=\"mwCKI\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCKM\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCKQ\">[</span>199<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCKU\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n<p id=\"mwCKY\">The <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Charité\" title=\"Charité\" id=\"mwCKc\">Charité</a> complex (Universitätsklinik Charité) is the largest <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./University_hospital\" title=\"University hospital\" class=\"mw-redirect\" id=\"mwCKg\">university hospital</a> in Europe, tracing back its origins to the year 1710. More than half of all German Nobel Prize winners in Physiology or Medicine, including <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Emil_von_Behring\" title=\"Emil von Behring\" id=\"mwCKk\">Emil von Behring</a>, Robert Koch and <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Paul_Ehrlich\" title=\"Paul Ehrlich\" id=\"mwCKo\">Paul Ehrlich</a>, have worked at the Charité. The Charité is spread over four campuses and comprises around 3,000 beds, 15,500 staff, 8,000 students, and more than 60 operating theaters, and it has a turnover of two billion euros annually.<sup about=\"#mwt782\" class=\"mw-ref reference\" id=\"cite_ref-Charité_–_Universitätsmedizin_Berlin_201-0\" rel=\"dc:references\" typeof=\"mw:Extension/ref\" data-mw='{\"name\":\"ref\",\"attrs\":{\"name\":\"Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin\"},\"body\":{\"id\":\"mw-reference-text-cite_note-Charité_–_Universitätsmedizin_Berlin-201\"}}'><a href=\"./Berlin#cite_note-Charité_–_Universitätsmedizin_Berlin-201\" id=\"mwCKs\"><span class=\"mw-reflink-text\" id=\"mwCKw\"><span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCK0\">[</span>200<span class=\"cite-bracket\" id=\"mwCK4\">]</span></span></a></sup></p>\n\n</section><section data-mw-section-id=\"41\" id=\"mwCK8\"><h2 id=\"Education_and_research\">Education and research</h2>\n<span about=\"#mwt783\" id=\"mwCLE\">Main article: <a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Education_in_Berlin\" title=\"Education in Berlin\">Education in Berlin</a></div>\n\n<figure class=\"mw-default-size mw-halign-right\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\" id=\"mwCLI\"><a href=\"./File:Berlin-Mitte_Humboldt-Uni_05-2014.jpg\" class=\"mw-file-description\" id=\"mwCLM\"><img resource=\"./File:Berlin-Mitte_Humboldt-Uni_05-2014.jpg\" src=\"//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/01/Berlin-Mitte_Humboldt-Uni_05-2014.jpg/250px-Berlin-Mitte_Humboldt-Uni_05-2014.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail\"
